Subject: Embeddings migration — adapter inventory & rerank eval sprint

Hi Samira / Lumenary team,

Thanks again for agreeing to the migration planning session. To keep momentum, here's a compact kickoff and asks so we can scope the adapter work and an initial rerank evaluation sprint.

Quick agenda (30–45m sync or async):
- Inventory: which vector store(s) you currently run / any sharding or multi-region constraints
- Adapter options: native connector vs. small adapter shim (we'll provide a template)
- Backfill approach: streaming vs. bulk upload windows, and desired RTO for query parity
- Rerank eval: sample prompt sets, metrics (MRR / P@k), and acceptance criteria
- Security / credentials / data retention checklist

Immediate asks from your side before we commit sprint dates:
1) Attach a small index snapshot (first 10k vectors) and schema (type + metadata fields).
2) Share whether you plan to use Pinecone / Milvus / Faiss / self-hosted DB and any geo constraints.
3) Confirm a preferred 1-week window in late Nov for a focused rerank eval (we suggested 20–27 Nov).

I've attached: migration_requirements.xlsx (checklist) and adapter_template.md (simple shim pattern we use).

If that all looks good we'll schedule a 30m kickoff and map owners; Marissa will lead adapter work and Jordan will own the backfill cadence.

Thanks,

--
Priyom Das
Customer Success, Redwood Inference

Hi Priyom,

Thanks — helpful agenda. Quick answers inline and attached a small snapshot.

- Snapshot: attached current_index_snapshot.json (first ~12k vectors, metadata sample). We've got ~120M vectors total (customer docs + metadata), ~1.2TB raw storage.
- Vector store: currently on a self-hosted Milvus cluster (v2.2) with 6 shards across two AZs; we also export nightly snapshots to S3.
- Geo: primary in us-west-2. No EU instances at the moment.

Timeline: the team can do an evaluation sprint the week of 22 Nov (Mon 22 — Sun 28) instead of 20–27 — slight preference for starting Mon 22. Full backfill would ideally happen during a weekend maintenance window (we prefer Dec 4–5).

Questions for you:
1) With 120M vectors, do you recommend a staging backfill first, or a direct migrate+switch?
2) We have custom metadata fields (customer_id, doc_type, freshness_ts); will your adapter preserve those for rerank priming?
3) Are there known limits for incremental writes during the backfill (i.e., will reads be impacted)?

Looping Jordan and Marissa for technical details. Attaching the snapshot now.

Best,
Samira Khan
Engineering Manager, Lumenary Labs
samira.k@lumenary.ai

All — thanks Samira for the snapshot. I've sketched a lightweight plan after a quick review of the artifact. High-level proposal below.

1) Adapter inventory & decision rationale- We can reuse our Milvus shim but need to add: shard-aware iterator, resume tokens for S3 snapshots, and metadata passthrough (customer_id, doc_type, freshness_ts).
- Risk: custom metadata types (nested objects) will require canonicalization upfront.

2) Backfill approach- Phase A (staging): stream the first 10% of vectors into a shadow index and run smoke queries + rerank against baseline.
- Phase B (bulk window): use parallel workers to bulk-insert remaining vectors during a 36–48h maintenance window.
- We'll provide scripts that checkpoint every 500k vectors (resume granularity).

3) Performance recommendations- Use HNSW for search with an efConstruction tuned for ingestion speed; consider int8 compression on payloads to reduce IO. Keep a small hot cache for recent docs to preserve latency.

4) Rerank evaluation sprint (proposed: 22–28 Nov)
- Objectives: ensure rerank model preserves relevance and identify any precision regressions.
- Tests: holdout set (5k queries), metrics: MRR, Precision@5, Response latency (p50/p95).
- Acceptance: <5% drop in MRR vs baseline OR product manager signoff after manual review.

5) Next steps and dates
- Action: Lumenary to grant a read-only S3 snapshot link + short-term API key for staged cluster by Nov 17.
- Marissa to deliver Milvus adapter prototype and benchmark by Nov 19.
- Priyom to schedule the kickoff on Nov 18 and coordinate the evaluation sprint to start Nov 22.

I'll put the adapter checklist and scripts into the shared Drive folder (link below).

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3c-lumenary-embed-migration
